instruction:
Upgrade Entrance Openings And Export CSV

This task starts from /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and may use /home/user/Desktop/init_plan.png as a local reference image. Modify the provided lobby shell by upgrading the entrance door and adding window openings, then save the required outputs as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv; /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv is not empty.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 1 IfcSpace, 4 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, 1 IfcRoof, 1 IfcDoor, 4 IfcWindow entities, 5 IfcOpeningElement entities, 5 IfcRelVoidsElement relationships, and 5 IfcRelFillsElement relationships.
4. The IFC model contains 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcFurniture, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcStair, and 0 IfcFlowTerminal entities.
5. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
6. The single IfcBuildingStorey is named exactly Ground Floor, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
7. The single IfcSpace is named exactly Lobby, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only, and has bounding-box dimensions 9.40 m by 5.40 m by 3.00 m, in any axis order, with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
8. The slab is named exactly Base Slab, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only, and has bounding-box dimensions 10.00 m by 6.00 m by 0.20 m, in any axis order, with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
9. The roof is named exactly Entrance Canopy, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only, and has bounding-box dimensions 2.20 m by 0.80 m by 0.18 m, in any axis order, with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
10. All spaces, walls, the slab, roof, door, and windows are spatially assigned to Ground Floor.
11. The opening-bearing products are named exactly Accessible Entrance Door, North Window A, North Window B, East Window A, and West Window A, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
12. Accessible Entrance Door is an IfcDoor that fills an opening in South Wall with opening width 1.20 m and opening height 2.20 m, each with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
13. North Window A and North Window B are IfcWindow entities that each fill an opening in North Wall with opening width 1.50 m and opening height 1.20 m, each with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
14. East Window A is an IfcWindow that fills an opening in East Wall with opening width 1.50 m and opening height 1.20 m, each with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
15. West Window A is an IfcWindow that fills an opening in West Wall with opening width 1.50 m and opening height 1.20 m, each with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
16. /home/user/Desktop/result.csv has exactly these headers in this order: GlobalId, Class, Width, Height, HostWall.
17. /home/user/Desktop/result.csv has exactly 5 data rows, one row for each final door or window by matching GlobalId.
18. For every CSV row, Class equals the matched IFC class, Width and Height equal the matched opening width and height with tolerance +/-0.02, and HostWall equals the matched host wall name.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
